claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group has revised the mechanical completion schedule for its third polypropylene line at Map Ta Phut from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028.

citations.quote: mechanical completion has moved from the second quarter of 2028 to the fourth quarter of 2028

claims.text: The delay was attributed to a longer-than-expected environmental permit amendment process for the revised flare tie-in and a schedule extension requested by the civil contractor due to unsuitable ground conditions requiring additional piling.

citations.quote: environmental permit amendment covering the revised flare tie-in took longer than the company had assumed... civil contractor requested a schedule extension after encountering unsuitable ground conditions at the foundation stage, which required additional piling

claims.text: The capital estimate for the third polypropylene line remains unchanged despite the schedule delay.

citations.quote: Andaman said the capital estimate is unchanged

claims.text: The delay does not affect Andaman Polymer Group's existing two polypropylene lines or the cracker at Map Ta Phut.

citations.quote: the delay does not affect the existing two polypropylene lines or the cracker

claims.text: The third polypropylene line is designed for a capacity of 300 kta and will use gas-phase technology, consistent with the site's existing two lines.

citations.quote: The line is designed for 300 kta and will use gas-phase technology, consistent with the site's existing two lines.

claims.text: Propylene for the third line will be supplied from the existing Map Ta Phut propylene unit, and no additional cracker capacity is required.

citations.quote: The company said propylene will be supplied from the existing Map Ta Phut propylene unit, and that no additional cracker capacity is required.

coverage_note: The most recent schedule update is from July 2026, revising mechanical completion to Q4 2028. No further updates or changes are reported in the available evidence.
